baseline_parity_policy: At N=500, process sigma=0.05, and P=10000, weak LASSO and weak OLS must reproduce the independently verified fixed sigma_obs=0.01 nominal records.
comparison_policy: Compare validation-selected raw full-dictionary LASSO with raw minimum-norm full-dictionary OLS on identical weak systems. Report matched-dictionary coefficient error as the primary state-recovery metric; report latent drift/profile errors secondarily and nested sampled-design error for pair quadrature.
condition_budget_policy: Nominal and process-noise conditions use N=500 and P=25000. Particle-number conditions use P=50N. Pair-count conditions use the declared P values at N=500, including the nominal P=25000.
data_policy: R=20 production candidate derived from the authoritative sigma_obs=0.01 protocol. Training, validation, and latent test trajectories are separate. Pair indices are redrawn at every observed time, shared across all tests and atoms at that time, and independent between training and validation.
failure_policy: Retain every prespecified repetition, nonconverged path candidate, boundary selection, rank deficiency, nonfinite coefficient, and missing metric. Do not rerun to improve a result.
pair_index_policy: At every observed time, draw ordered off-diagonal pairs with replacement. Draws are independent across time. The one draw at a time is shared by all spatial tests, temporal tests, and dictionary atoms. Training and validation use independent pair seeds and therefore independent pair streams.
pairing_policy: Within each repetition, process-noise conditions share standard-normal training and validation observation-error arrays. Particle-number conditions use the corresponding prefixes of arrays generated at N=500. Pair-count conditions share the same observed trajectories and nested pair samples. Training, validation, and latent test trajectories remain separate.
selection_policy: Each nominal, process-noise, and particle-number condition selects raw LASSO using its independent sampled validation weak system at the same P. The pair-count sweep selects lambda once at P0=25000 using an independent sampled validation system and fixes that absolute lambda for every P within the repetition. Truth and latent test metrics are excluded from fitting and selection.
source_preservation_policy: Copy the model, dictionary, weak tests, process-noise and particle-number grids, estimator, seeds, evaluation settings, observation-noise protocol, and R=20 from the authoritative frozen protocol. Change only sampled-pair mode/budgets, add P=25000 to the pair-count grid, and change pair-count lambda selection from Pmax to P0=25000.
